verses.text: “E go come be say, if you go diligently listen to di voice of di Lord your God, to observe to do all im commandments wey I command you today, di Lord your God go set you high above all di nations of di earth.
All dem blessings go come on you, and overtake you, if you listen to di voice of di Lord your God:
Blessed go you be for di city, and blessed go you be for di field.
Blessed go be di fruit of your body, and di fruit of your ground, and di fruit of your livestock, di increase of your cattle, and di young of your flock.
Blessed go be your basket and your kneading bowl.
Blessed go you be when you come in, and blessed go you be when you go out.
Di Lord go cause your enemies wey rise up against you to dey struck before you. Dem go come out against you one way, and flee before you seven ways.
Di Lord go command di blessing on you for your barns, and for all wey you put your hand to. E go bless you for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you.
Di Lord go establish you for one holy people to imself, as e don swear to you, if you keep di commandments of di Lord your God, and waka for im ways.
All di peoples of di earth go see say you dey called by di name of di Lord, and dem go dey afraid of you.
Di Lord go make you plenteous for goods, for di fruit of your body, and for di fruit of your livestock, and for di fruit of your ground, for di land wey di Lord swear to your papa dem to give you.
Di Lord go open to you im good treasure, di sky, to give di rain of your land for im season, and to bless all di work of your hand. You go lend to many nations, and you no go borrow.
Di Lord go make you di head, and not di tail. You go be above only, and you no go be beneath, if you listen to di commandments of di Lord your God, wey I command you today, to observe and to do dem,
and no go turn aside from any of di words wey I command you today, to di right hand, or to di left, to go after other gods to serve dem.

But e go come be say, if you no go listen to di voice of di Lord your God, to observe to do all im commandments and im statutes wey I command you today, say all dem curses go come on you, and overtake you:
Cursed go you be for di city, and cursed go you be for di field.
Cursed go be your basket and your kneading bowl.
Cursed go be di fruit of your body, and di fruit of your ground, di increase of your cattle, and di young of your flock.
Cursed go you be when you come in, and cursed go you be when you go out.

Di Lord go send on you curses, confusion, and rebuke, for all wey you put your hand to do, until you dey destroyed, and until you perish quickly, because of di evil of your doings, by wey you don forsake me.
Di Lord go make di pestilence cling to you, until e don consume you from off di land, wia you dey go in to possess am.
Di Lord go strike you with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with fiery heat, and with sword, and with blight, and with mildew. Dem go pursue you until you perish.
Your sky wey dey over your head go be bronze, and di earth wey dey under you go be iron.
Di Lord go make di rain of your land powder and dust. From heaven e go come down on you, until you dey destroyed.
Di Lord go cause you to dey struck before your enemies. You go go out one way against dem, and flee seven ways before dem. You go be one horror to all di kingdoms of di earth.
Your dead body go be food to all birds of di sky, and to di animals of di earth, and no man go frighten dem away.
Di Lord go strike you with di boils of Egypt, and with tumors, and with scurvy, and with itch, wey you no fit dey healed.
Di Lord go strike you with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
You go grope at noonday, as di blind man dey grope for darkness, and you no go prosper for your ways. You go be only oppressed and robbed always, and no one go save you.
You go betroth one wife, and another man go lie with am. You go build one house, and you no go dwell inside am. You go plant one vineyard, and you no go use di fruit of am.

Your ox go dey slaughtered before your eyes, and you no go eat of am. Your donkey go dey violently taken away from before your face, and e no go dey restored to you. Your sheep go dey given to your enemies, and you no go get anyone to save you.
Your pikin man dem and your pikin woman dem go dey given to another people, and your eyes go look, and fail with longing for dem all di day, and dere go be no power for your hand.
One nation wey you no know go eat di fruit of your ground, and all your labours. You go be only oppressed and crushed always,
so that you go dey driven mad for di sight of your eyes wey you go see.
Di Lord go strike you for di knees, and for di legs, with sore boils wey no fit dey healed, from di sole of your foot to di top of your head.
Di Lord go bring you, and your king wey you go set over you, to one nation wey you no know, nor your papa dem. Dere you go serve other gods, wood and stone.
You go become one astonishment, one proverb, and one byword, among all di peoples wia di Lord go lead you away.
You go carry much seed out to di field, and go gather little in, because di locust go consume am.
You go plant vineyards and dress dem, but you no go drink of di wine, nor gather di grapes, because di worm go eat dem.
You go get olive trees throughout all your borders, but you no go anoint yourself with di oil, because your olive go drop off.
You go born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem, but dem no go be yours, because dem go go into captivity.
All your trees and di fruit of your ground, di locust go possess.
Di stranger wey dey among you go mount up above you higher and higher, and you go come down lower and lower.
E go lend to you, and you no go lend to am. E go be di head, and you go be di tail.

All dem curses go come on you, and go pursue you, and overtake you, until you dey destroyed, because you no listen to di voice of di Lord your God, to keep im commandments and im statutes wey e command you.
Dem go be on you for one sign and for one wonder, and on your seed forever.
Because you no serve di Lord your God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of di abundance of all things,

therefore you go serve your enemies wey di Lord go send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things. E go put one yoke of iron on your neck, until e don destroy you.
Di Lord go bring one nation against you from far, from di end of di earth, as di eagle dey swoop down, one nation whose language you no go understand,
one nation of fierce face, wey no go respect di old, nor show favour to di young.

E go eat di fruit of your livestock, and di fruit of your ground, until you dey destroyed, wey no go leave you grain, new wine, or oil, di increase of your cattle, or di young of your flock, until e don cause you to perish.

E go besiege you for all your gates, until your high and fortified walls, wia you trust, come down throughout all your land. E go besiege you for all your gates throughout all your land, wey di Lord your God don give you.

You go eat di fruit of your own body, di flesh of your pikin man dem and of your pikin woman dem, wey di Lord your God don give you, for di siege and for di distress wey your enemies go distress you with.
Di man wey dey tender among una, and very delicate, im eye go dey evil toward im brother, and toward di wife of im bosom, and toward di remnant of im pikin dem wey e don leave,
so that e no go give to any of dem of di flesh of im pikin dem wey e go eat, because e get nothing left, for di siege and for di distress wey your enemy go distress you with for all your gates.

Di tender and delicate woman among una, wey no go venture to set di sole of im foot on di ground for delicateness and tenderness, di woman eye go dey evil toward di husband of im bosom, and toward im pikin man, and toward im pikin woman,

and toward di afterbirth wey come out from between im feet, and toward im pikin dem wey e go born, because e go eat dem for want of all things secretly, for di siege and for di distress wey your enemy go distress you with for your gates.
If you no observe to do all di words of dis law wey dem write for dis book, so that you go fear dis glorious and awesome name, di Lord your God,
di Lord go make your plagues wonderful, and di plagues of your seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
E go bring on you again all di diseases of Egypt, wey you dey afraid of, and dem go cling to you.
Also every sickness, and every plague, wey no dey written for di book of dis law, di Lord go bring dem on you, until you dey destroyed.
Una go dey left few in number, whereas una don be as di stars of heaven for multitude, because you no listen to di voice of di Lord your God.

E go come be say, as di Lord rejoice over una to do una good, and to multiply una, so di Lord go rejoice over una to cause una to perish, and to destroy una. Una go dey plucked from off di land wia you dey go in to possess am.
Di Lord go scatter you among all peoples, from di one end of di earth even to di other end of di earth. Dere you go serve other gods, wey you no know, you nor your papa dem, wood and stone.
Among dem nations you go find no ease, and no rest go dey for di sole of your foot, but di Lord go give you dere one trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
Your life go hang in doubt before you. You go fear night and day, and go get no assurance of your life.
For di morning you go talk, ‘I wish say na evening!’ and for di evening you go talk, ‘I wish say na morning!’ for di fear of your heart wey you go fear, and for di sight of your eyes wey you go see.

Di Lord go bring you into Egypt again with ships, by di way wey I talk to you, ‘You go see am no more again.’ Dere una go offer yourselves for sale to your enemies for male slaves and female slaves, and no man go buy una.”
Dem na di words of di covenant wey di Lord command Moses to make with di pikin dem of Israel for di land of Moab, besides di covenant wey e make with dem for Horeb.
Moses call to all Israel, and talk to dem, “Una don see all wey di Lord do before una eyes for di land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all im servants, and to all im land,
di great trials wey your eyes see, di signs, and dem great wonders.
But di Lord never give una one heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, to dis day.
I don lead una 40 years for di wilderness. Una clothes no wear out on una, and your sandals no wear out on your feet.
Una no eat bread, neither una drink wine or strong drink, so that una go know say I na di Lord una God.
When una come to dis place, Sihon di king of Heshbon, and Og di king of Bashan, come out against us to battle, and we strike dem.
We take dem land, and give am for inheritance to di Reubenites, and to di Gadites, and to di half tribe of Manasseh.
Keep therefore di words of dis covenant, and do dem, so that una go prosper for all wey una do.
Una stand dis day all of una before di Lord una God: una heads, una tribes, una elders, and una officers, even all di men of Israel,
una little ones, una wives, and di stranger wey dey inside una camp, from di one wey chop una wood to di one wey draw una water,
so that you go enter into di covenant of di Lord your God, and into im oath, wey di Lord your God make with you today,
so that e go establish you today to imself for one people, and so that e go be to you God, as e don speak to you, and as e don swear to your papa dem, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Neither with una only I make dis covenant and dis oath,
but with am wey stand here with us today before di Lord our God, and also with am wey no dey here with us today,
because una know how we dwell for di land of Egypt, and how we pass through di middle of di nations wey una pass,
and una don see dem abominations, and dem idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, wey dey among dem.

So that dere no go be among una man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turn away today from di Lord our God, to go serve di gods of dem nations. Dat dere no go be among una one root wey bear gall and wormwood,
and so that when e hear di words of dis curse, e go bless imself for im heart, talk, ‘I go dey safe, though I waka for di stubbornness of my heart,’ so that di moist go dey swept away with di dry.

Di Lord no go pardon am, but di anger of di Lord and im jealousy go smoke against dat man, and every curse wey dey written for dis book go lie on am, and di Lord go blot out im name from under heaven.
Di Lord go set am apart for evil out of all di tribes of Israel, according to all di curses of di covenant wey dey written for dis book of di law.

Di generation to come, una pikin dem wey go rise up after una, and di foreigner wey go come from one far land, go talk, when dem see di plagues of dat land, and di sicknesses wey di Lord don lay on am,

and all im land brimstone, and salt, and burning, wey no dey sown, nor bear, nor any grass grow inside am, like di overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, wey di Lord overthrow for im anger and for im wrath,
even all di nations go talk, ‘Why di Lord don do dis to dis land? Wetin be di heat of dis great anger?’
Men go talk, ‘Because dem don forsake di covenant of di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, wey e make with dem when e bring dem out of di land of Egypt,
and go serve other gods, and worship dem, gods wey dem no know, and wey e no give to dem.
Therefore di anger of di Lord dey kindled against dis land, to bring on am all di curse wey dey written for dis book.
Di Lord don root dem out of dem land with anger, and with wrath, and with great indignation, and cast dem into another land, as e dey today.’
Di secret things belong to di Lord our God, but di things wey dey revealed belong to us and to our pikin dem forever, so that we go do all di words of dis law.”
“E go come be say, when all dem things don come on you, di blessing and di curse, wey I don set before you, and you go call dem to mind among all di nations, wia di Lord your God don drive you,
and go return to di Lord your God, and go obey im voice according to all wey I command you today, you and your pikin dem, with all your heart, and with all your soul,
di Lord your God go turn your captivity, and have compassion on you, and go return and gather you from all di peoples, wia di Lord your God don scatter you.
If any of your outcasts dey for di uttermost parts of heaven, from dere di Lord your God go gather you, and from dere e go bring you back.
Di Lord your God go bring you into di land wey your papa dem possess, and you go possess am. E go do you good, and multiply you above your papa dem.
Di Lord your God go circumcise your heart, and di heart of your seed, to love di Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, so that you go live.
Di Lord your God go put all dem curses on your enemies, and on dem wey hate you, wey persecute you.
You go return and obey di voice of di Lord, and do all im commandments wey I command you today.

Di Lord your God go make you plenteous for all di work of your hand, for di fruit of your body, and for di fruit of your livestock, and for di fruit of your ground, for good, because di Lord go again rejoice over you for good, as e rejoice over your papa dem,
if you obey di voice of di Lord your God, to keep im commandments and im statutes wey dey written for dis book of di law, if you turn to di Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul.
For dis commandment wey I command you today, e no dey too hard for you, neither e dey far off.
E no dey for heaven, say you go talk, ‘Who go go up for us to heaven, and bring am to us, and make us hear am, so that we go do am?’
Neither e dey beyond di sea, say you go talk, ‘Who go go over di sea for us, and bring am to us, and make us hear am, so that we go do am?’
But di word dey very near to you, for your mouth, and for your heart, so that you go do am.
Look, I don set before you today life and good, death and evil.

If you obey di commandments of di Lord your God wey I command you today, to love di Lord your God, to waka for im ways, and to keep im commandments and im statutes and im ordinances, so that you go live and multiply, and di Lord your God go bless you for di land wia you dey go in to possess am.
But if your heart turn away, and you no go obey, but go dey drawn away and worship other gods, and serve dem,
I declare to una today say una go surely perish. Una no go prolong una days for di land wia you dey pass over di Jordan to go in to possess am.
I call heaven and earth to witness against una today. I don set before you life and death, di blessing and di curse. Therefore choose life, so that you and your seed go live,

to love di Lord your God, to obey im voice, and to hold fast to am, because na im be your life, and di length of your days, so that you go dwell for di land wey di Lord swear to your papa dem, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give dem.”
Moses go and speak dem words to all Israel.
E talk to dem, “I dey 120 years old today. I no fit go out and come in again. Di Lord don talk to me, ‘You no go go over dis Jordan.’
Di Lord your God, na im go go over before you. E go destroy dem nations from before you, and you go dispossess dem. Joshua go go over before you, as di Lord don speak.
Di Lord go do to dem as e do to Sihon and to Og, di kings of di Amorites, and to dem land, wey e destroy.
Di Lord go deliver dem up before you, and una go do to dem according to all di commandment wey I don command una.
Make una dey strong and courageous. No fear, nor dey afraid of dem, because di Lord your God na im dey go with you. E no go fail you, nor forsake you.”

Moses call Joshua, and talk to am for di sight of all Israel, “Dey strong and courageous, because you go go with dis people into di land wey di Lord don swear to dem papa dem to give dem, and you go cause dem to inherit am.
Di Lord na im dey go before you. E go dey with you. E no go fail you, neither forsake you. No fear, neither dey dismayed.”
Moses write dis law, and give am to di priests, di pikin man dem of Levi, wey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord, and to all di elders of Israel.
Moses command dem, talk, “At di end of every seven years, for di set time of di year of release, for di feast of booths,
when all Israel come to appear before di Lord your God for di place wey e go choose, you go read dis law before all Israel for dem hearing.

Gather di people together, di men and di women and di little ones, and di stranger wey dey inside your gates, so that dem go hear, and so that dem go learn, and fear di Lord your God, and observe to do all di words of dis law,
and so that dem pikin dem, wey no know am, go hear, and learn to fear di Lord your God, as long as una live for di land wey una dey go over di Jordan to possess.”

Di Lord talk to Moses, “Look, your days don draw near wey you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves for di Tent of Meeting, so that I go commission am.” Moses and Joshua go, and present demself for di Tent of Meeting.
Di Lord appear for di Tent for one pillar of cloud. Di pillar of cloud stand over di door of di Tent.

Di Lord talk to Moses, “Look, you go sleep with your papa dem. Dis people go rise up, and play di prostitute after di gods of di strangers of di land, wia dem dey go to dey among dem, and go forsake me, and break my covenant wey I don make with dem.

My anger go dey kindled against dem for dat day, and I go forsake dem, and I go hide my face from dem, and dem go dey devoured, and many evils and troubles go come on dem. Dem go talk for dat day, ‘Dem evils no come on us because our God no dey among us?’
I go surely hide my face for dat day, because of all di evil wey dem don do, in dat dem don turn to other gods.
Now therefore write dis song for yourselves, and teach am to di pikin dem of Israel. Put am for dem mouths, so that dis song go be one witness for me against di pikin dem of Israel.

Because when I don bring dem into di land wey I swear to dem papa dem, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey, and dem don eat and dey full, and grow fat, dem go turn to other gods, and serve dem, and despise me, and break my covenant.

E go come be say, when many evils and troubles don come on dem, say dis song go testify before dem as one witness, because e no go dey forgotten out of di mouth of dem seed. Because I know dem imagination wey dem dey form dis day, before I don bring dem into di land wey I swear.”
So Moses write dis song di same day, and teach am to di pikin dem of Israel.
E commission Joshua di pikin of Nun, and talk, “Dey strong and courageous, because you go bring di pikin dem of Israel into di land wey I swear to dem, and I go dey with you.”
E come be say, when Moses don finish writing di words of dis law for one book, until dem dey finished,
Moses command di Levites, wey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord, talk,
“Take dis book of di law, and put am by di side of di ark of di covenant of di Lord your God, so that e go dey dere for one witness against you.
Because I know your rebellion, and your stiff neck. Look, while I dey yet alive with una today, una don dey rebellious against di Lord. How much more after my death?
Gather to me all di elders of una tribes, and una officers, so that I go speak dem words for dem ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against dem.

Because I know say after my death una go utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from di way wey I command una, and evil go befall una for di latter days, because una go do wetin dey evil for di sight of di Lord, to provoke am to anger through di work of una hands.”
Moses speak for di ears of all di assembly of Israel di words of dis song, until dem dey finished.
“Listen, you heavens, and I go speak. Hear, you earth, di words of my mouth.
My teaching go drop as di rain. My speech go distill as di dew, as di showers on di tender grass, as di showers on di herb.
Because I go proclaim di name of di Lord. Ascribe greatness to our God!
Di Rock, im work dey perfect, because all im ways na justice. One God of faithfulness and without iniquity, just and right na im be.
Dem don corrupt demself. Dem no be im pikin dem, because of dem blemish. Dem na one perverse and crooked generation.
Na so you go repay di Lord, you foolish and unwise people? No be im be your papa wey don purchase you? E don make you, and establish you.
Remember di days of old. Consider di years of many generations. Ask your papa, and e go show you, your elders, and dem go tell you.
When di Most High give to di nations dem inheritance, when e separate di pikin dem of men, e set di borders of di peoples according to di number of di pikin dem of Israel.
Because di Lord portion na im people. Jacob na di lot of im inheritance.
E find am for one desert land, and for di waste howling wilderness. E encircle am. E care for am. E keep am as di apple of im eye.
As one eagle wey stir up im nest, wey flutter over im young, e spread abroad im wings, e take dem, e bear dem on im pinions.
Di Lord alone lead am. Dere no dey any foreign god with am.
E make am ride on di high places of di earth. E eat di increase of di field. E make am suck honey out of di rock, and oil out of di flinty rock,
butter of di herd, and milk of di flock, with fat of lambs, and rams of di breed of Bashan, and goats, with di finest of di wheat. From di blood of di grape you drink wine.
But Jeshurun grow fat, and kick. You grow fat, you grow thick, you cover with fatness. E forsake God wey make am, and scoff at di Rock of im salvation.
Dem provoke am to jealousy with strange gods. With abominations dem provoke am to anger.
Dem sacrifice to demons, wey no be God, to gods wey dem no know, to new gods wey come newly up, wey una papa dem no fear.
Of di Rock wey bear you, you dey unmindful, and you don forget God wey form you.
Di Lord see am, and reject dem, because of provocation of im pikin man dem and im pikin woman dem.
‘I go hide my face from dem. I go see wetin dem end go be, because dem na one very perverse generation, pikin dem in wey no faithfulness dey.

Dem don move me to jealousy with wetin no be God. Dem don provoke me to anger with dem vanities. I go move dem to jealousy with dem wey no be one people. I go provoke dem to anger with one foolish nation.
Because one fire don kindle for my anger, and e burn to di lowest Sheol, and devour di earth with im increase, and set on fire di foundations of di mountains.
I go heap evils on dem. I go spend my arrows on dem.
Dem go dey wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I go send di teeth of beasts on dem, with di venom of crawling things of di dust.
Outside di sword go bereave, and inside di rooms terror, both young man and virgin, di nursing baby with di man of grey hair.
I talk say I go scatter dem afar, I go make di memory of dem cease from among men,
if I no fear di provocation of di enemy, make dem adversaries no misjudge, make dem no talk say dem hand dey high, and say di Lord no do all dis.’
Because dem na one nation wey lack counsel, and no understanding dey inside dem.
If only dem dey wise, dem go understand dis. Dem go consider dem latter end!
How one man go chase 1,000, and two put 10,000 to flight, except dem Rock don sell dem, and di Lord don deliver dem up?
Because dem rock no be like our Rock, even our enemies themselves judge.
Because dem vine na of di vine of Sodom, and of di fields of Gomorrah. Dem grapes na grapes of poison. Dem clusters dey bitter.
Dem wine na di poison of serpents, and di cruel venom of asps.
‘Dis no dey laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
Vengeance na mine, and recompense, for di time when dem foot go slip, because di day of dem calamity dey near, and di things wey go come on dem dey hasten.
Because di Lord go judge im people, and have compassion on im servants, when e see say dem power don go, and none remain, shut up or left at large.
E go ask where dem gods dey, di rock wey dem take refuge in,
wey eat di fat of dem sacrifices, and drink di wine of dem drink offering. Make dem rise up and help una. Make dem be una protection.
See now say I, even I, na am, and dere no dey god with me. I kill, and I make alive. I wound, and I heal. Dere no dey anyone wey fit deliver out of my hand.
Because I lift up my hand to heaven, and talk, As I live forever,
if I sharpen my glittering sword, and my hand take hold on judgment, I go take vengeance on my adversaries, and go repay dem wey hate me.
I go make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword go devour flesh, with di blood of di slain and di captives, from di head of di leaders of di enemy.’
Rejoice, you nations, with im people, because e go avenge di blood of im servants, and go take vengeance on im adversaries, and go make atonement for im land and for im people.”
Moses come and speak all di words of dis song for di ears of di people, e, and Joshua di pikin of Nun.
Moses finish speaking all dem words to all Israel,
and e talk to dem, “Set your hearts to all di words wey I testify among una today, wey una go command una pikin dem to observe to do, even all di words of dis law.
Because e no be one vain thing for una, because e na una life. Through dis thing una go prolong una days for di land wia una dey go over di Jordan to possess am.”
Di Lord speak to Moses dat same day, talk,
“Go up into dis mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, wey dey di land of Moab, wey dey opposite Jericho, and see di land of Canaan, wey I give to di pikin dem of Israel for possession.
Die for di mountain wia you go up, and dey gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother die for Mount Hor, and dey gathered to im people,
because una trespass against me among di pikin dem of Israel for di waters of Meribah Kadesh, for di wilderness of Zin, because una no uphold me as holy among di pikin dem of Israel.
Because you go see di land from afar, but you no go go in dere, into di land wey I give to di pikin dem of Israel.”
Dis na di blessing, wherewith Moses di man of God bless di pikin dem of Israel before im death.
E talk, “Di Lord come from Sinai, and rise from Seir to dem. E shine out from Mount Paran, and e come from di ten thousands of holy ones, with flaming fire at im right hand.
Yes, e love di people. All im holy ones dey for your hand. Dem sit down at your feet. Everyone go receive of your words.
Moses command us one law, one inheritance for di assembly of Jacob.
E dey king for Jeshurun, when di heads of di people gather, di tribes of Israel together.
Make Reuben live, and no die, neither make im men dey few.
Dis na di blessing of Judah: e talk, ‘Hear, Lord, di voice of Judah, and bring am in to im people. With im hands e contend for imself. You go be im help against im adversaries.’
Of Levi e talk, ‘Your Thummim and your Urim dey with your godly one, wey you prove for Massah, with whom you strive for di waters of Meribah,
wey talk of im papa and of im mama say e no see dem, neither e acknowledge im brothers, nor know im own pikin dem. Because dem don observe your word, and keep your covenant.
Dem go teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. Dem go put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
Bless, Lord, im substance, and accept di work of im hands. Strike through di loins of dem wey rise against am, and of dem wey hate am, so that dem no go rise again.’
Of Benjamin e talk, ‘Di beloved of di Lord go dwell in safety by am. E cover am all di day long. E dwell between im shoulders.’
Of Joseph e talk, ‘Im land dey blessed by di Lord, with di precious things of heaven, with di dew, and from di deep wey lie beneath,
with di precious things of di fruits of di sun, with di precious things of di growth of di moons,
with di best things of di ancient mountains, with di precious things of di everlasting hills,
with di precious things of di earth and im fullness, and di good will of am wey dwell for di bush. Make am come on di head of Joseph, on di crown of di head of am wey dey separate from im brothers.

Im glory na like di firstborn of im herd, and im horns na di horns of di wild ox. With dem e go push di peoples, all of dem, to di ends of di earth. Dem na di ten thousands of Ephraim, and dem na di thousands of Manasseh.’
Of Zebulun e talk, ‘Rejoice, Zebulun, for your going out, and Issachar, for your tents.
Dem go call peoples to di mountain. Dere dem go offer sacrifices of righteousness, because dem go draw out di abundance of di seas, and di hidden treasures of di sand.’
Of Gad e talk, ‘Blessed be im wey enlarge Gad. E dwell as one lioness, and tear di arm, yes, di crown of di head.
E provide di first part for imself, because dere dey di ruler portion reserved. E come with di heads of di people. E execute di righteousness of di Lord, and im ordinances with Israel.’
Of Dan e talk, ‘Dan na one lion cub, wey leap out of Bashan.’
Of Naphtali e talk, ‘Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with di blessing of di Lord, possess di west and di south.’
Of Asher e talk, ‘Asher dey blessed with pikin dem. Make am be acceptable to im brothers. Make am dip im foot for oil.
Your bars go be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength go be.’
Dere no dey any like God, Jeshurun, wey ride through di heavens for your help, and for im excellency through di skies.
Di eternal God na your dwelling place. Underneath na di everlasting arms. E thrust out di enemy from before you, and tell dem make dem destroy.
Israel dwell in safety, di fountain of Jacob alone, for one land of grain and new wine. Yes, im heavens drop down dew.
You dey happy, Israel! Who dey like you, one people wey di Lord save, di shield of your help, and di sword of your excellency? Your enemies go submit to you. You go tread on dem high places.”
Moses go up from di plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to di top of Pisgah, wey dey opposite Jericho. Di Lord show am all di land of Gilead, to Dan,
and all Naphtali, and di land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all di land of Judah, to di western sea,
and di South, and di plain of di valley of Jericho di city of palm trees, to Zoar.
Di Lord talk to am, “Dis na di land wey I swear to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, talk, ‘I go give am to your seed.’ I don cause you to see am with your eyes, but you no go go over dere.”
So Moses di servant of di Lord die dere for di land of Moab, according to di word of di Lord.
E bury am for di valley for di land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man know im burial place to dis day.
Moses dey 120 years old when e die. Im eye no dim, nor im natural force abate.
Di pikin dem of Israel weep for Moses for di plains of Moab 30 days. So di days of weeping and mourning for Moses end.
Joshua di pikin of Nun dey full of di spirit of wisdom, because Moses don lay im hands on am. Di pikin dem of Israel listen to am, and do as di Lord command Moses.
Dere never rise one prophet since for Israel like Moses, wey di Lord know face to face,
for all di signs and di wonders, wey di Lord send am to do for di land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all im servants, and to all im land,
and for all di mighty hand, and for all di great terror, wey Moses show for di sight of all Israel.
